test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Corona virus has not yet reached __some parts in world__.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'some parts of the world.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We know that a definite is used when we talk about a specific thing.
 
• In the given sentence, we are talking about **a specific world**, that is the world in which *we humans live*.
 
• So we should use a **definite article **(*the*) before the word '**world**.'
 
• And the **preposition **'*of*' expresses the relationship *of a part of something to its whole*.
 
 
• **Example:** *Some parts **of **his body were injured.*
 
 
 
• Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer.

And the correct sentence is: *Corona virus has not yet reached **some parts of the world**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Both a definite or an indefinite article can be used with the word 'world,' it depends on which context it has been used.
 
 
• If you are talking about **a specific world**, then u would use the world.

 
 
• Example: *If Humans don’t act quickly, **the world **will be irreparably damaged.*
 
 
 
• If you are talking about a place that is **not specific or imaginary**, then use a world.
 
 
• Example: *We could live in **a **perfect **world **if we all exhibited a love for each other.*
